crossRefs.note: Then the king answered, “Give her the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

translations.web: Then the king answered, “Give her the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”
translations.bsb: Then the king gave his ruling: “Give the living baby to the first woman. By no means should you kill him; she is his mother.”
translations.kjv: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
translations.asv: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
